scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 37 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-monastic-island-of-reichenau-halb.story: From Reichenau it runs 343 km to Reichenau; allow about 5 h 55 of riding. The stops in between: Weier I - III, Storen-Wildsberg, Oterswil / Insel Eielen and Halbinsel. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It crosses from Germany into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. An island ride, so the sea is never far.

legend-passo-di-giau-dolomites.slogan: Passo di Giau · Dolomites – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-passo-di-giau-dolomites.story: The Great Dolomite Road links Giau, Falzarego, Pordoi and Sella in one day. From Selva di Cadore it runs 19 km to Cortina d'Ampezzo; allow about 21 min of riding. The highest point is about 2,250 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Passo di Giau · Dolomites
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 6 km this is Passo di Giau · Dolomites, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
